title: 束筒高層結構系統~Bundled-tube tall-building systems
focus: 把數個框架筒束在一起以減少剪力滯後、並讓筒體逐段截止的束筒系統，從鋼構威利斯大樓到混凝土六角束筒~Bundling framed tubes to cut shear lag and let tubes stop at different heights, from the steel Willis Tower to hexagonal concrete bundles
summary: 以威利斯大樓與 One Magnificent Mile 為例，從框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒如何以內部腹框縮短翼面跨度出發，理解九個 75 英尺方筒的逐段截止，處理預製樹狀柱梁段與沉箱基礎、筒體截止處的力流重分配、混凝土六角束筒，再到邊界層風洞試驗與以柱應變驗證剪力滯後，最後是外殼溫度效應與既有束筒超高層的改造交接。~Using Willis Tower and One Magnificent Mile, start from shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling shortens flange spans with interior web frames, understand the staged termination of nine 75-foot tubes, handle prefabricated column-tree units and caisson foundations, force redistribution where tubes stop and hexagonal concrete bundles, then boundary-layer wind-tunnel testing and verifying shear lag from column strains, ending with envelope thermal effects and the retrofit and handover of an existing bundled-tube supertall.

units.anchor: 框架筒剪力滯後~Shear lag in a framed tube
units.title: 框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒的解法~Shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling helps
units.mechanism: 框架筒以密排的外柱與深窗間梁組成一個「有孔的箱」，側力下垂直於風向的翼面柱以軸力抵抗傾覆。但力量要經由窗間梁的剪力從角柱傳到翼面中央，梁有彈性，中央柱分到的軸力比角柱少，這就是剪力滯後，使翼面的效率降低。翼面越寬，滯後越嚴重。束筒把建築分成幾個較小的筒，筒與筒之間的內部框架也是腹面，等於把翼面切成較短的跨度，讓翼面柱的軸力分布更均勻，整體抗傾覆效率提高。~A framed tube uses closely spaced exterior columns and deep spandrel beams to form a perforated box, and under lateral load the flange columns perpendicular to the wind resist overturning in axial force. But force must travel from the corner columns to the middle of the flange through shear in the flexible spandrels, so middle columns pick up less axial force than corner columns; this shear lag lowers flange efficiency, and the wider the flange, the worse it gets. A bundled tube divides the building into several smaller tubes whose shared interior frames also act as webs, cutting the flange into shorter spans so that flange-column forces are more uniform and overall overturning efficiency rises.
units.model: 以拋物線近似翼面柱應力 σ(x) = σ_c·[r + (1 − r)(2x/b)²]，平均效率 η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − r)。單一寬筒中央與角柱應力比 r = 0.4 時 η = 0.60；束筒內部腹框使 r 提高到 0.85 時 η = 0.90，同樣角柱應力下翼面能提供的抗傾覆力約增加 50%。數值為教學假設。~Approximate flange-column stress with a parabola σ(x) = σ_c·[r + (1 − r)(2x/b)²], giving an average efficiency η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − r). For a single wide tube with a centre-to-corner stress ratio r = 0.4, η = 0.60; interior web frames in a bundle raising r to 0.85 give η = 0.90, so for the same corner stress the flange provides about 50% more overturning resistance. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在三維模型中輸出側力下翼面各柱的軸力分布，計算中央與角柱的比值，並比較單筒與束筒配置；同時確認窗間梁的剪力與變形是否在設計範圍，因為滯後的程度直接取決於這些梁的勁度。~Output the axial-force distribution across flange columns under lateral load from the three-dimensional model, compute the centre-to-corner ratio and compare single-tube and bundled layouts; check also that spandrel shears and deformations are within design, since the degree of shear lag depends directly on their stiffness.
units.failure: 若設計時以平面保持平面的梁理論假設翼面柱均勻受力，角柱的實際軸力會被低估，可能在強風或地震時先行降伏或在續接處開裂；窗間梁若因開大窗而變淺，剪力滯後加劇，整棟樓比預期柔。~Assuming plane sections and uniform flange forces in design underestimates real corner-column forces, which can yield first or crack at splices in strong wind or earthquakes; shallower spandrels from larger windows worsen shear lag and leave the building more flexible than expected.
units.misconception: 框架筒的翼面柱會平均分擔傾覆力。~Flange columns of a framed tube share overturning force equally.
units.practice: 在設計報告中列出翼面柱的軸力分布圖與剪力滯後比，角柱與其續接按實際最大軸力設計；建築若要加大窗洞或改變窗間梁深度，須由結構工程師重新評估滯後效應。~Include flange-column force distributions and shear-lag ratios in the design report, design corner columns and their splices for the actual maximum force, and have the structural engineer reassess shear lag before any enlargement of windows or change in spandrel depth.

units.title: 九個 75 英尺方筒與逐段截止~Nine 75-foot tubes and staged terminations
units.mechanism: 威利斯大樓（原西爾斯大樓）由九個約 75 英尺（約 22.9 m）見方、內部無柱的方筒以 3×3 排列組成，底部總寬約 225 英尺（約 68.6 m）。九個筒在第 50 層以下全部存在，之後依序截止：第 50 層西北與東南兩筒結束，第 66 層東北與西南兩筒結束，第 90 層北、東、南三筒結束，只剩兩筒到頂。逐段截止讓上部平面縮小、受風面積減少，同時形成退縮的外觀；但每一次截止都會造成勁度與質量的突然變化，必須在截止層以斜撐或帶狀桁架重新分配力量。~Willis Tower, formerly the Sears Tower, consists of nine column-free square tubes about 75 ft (about 22.9 m) on a side arranged in a 3×3 grid, about 225 ft (about 68.6 m) wide at the base. All nine rise to level 50 and then stop in stages: the northwest and southeast tubes end at level 50, the northeast and southwest at level 66, and the north, east and south at level 90, leaving two tubes to the top. Staged termination shrinks the upper plan and reduces wind area while creating the stepped profile; but every termination causes an abrupt change in stiffness and mass, so diagonals or belt trusses at those levels must redistribute forces.
units.model: 單筒面積 22.86² ≈ 523 m²：9 筒約 4,703 m²、7 筒約 3,658 m²、5 筒約 2,613 m²、2 筒約 1,045 m²。第 90 層以上的平面只剩底部的約 22%，該段的抗彎慣性矩與受風寬度同時減少，勁度變化可達數倍。尺寸取自公開資料，比例為計算結果。~One tube is 22.86² ≈ 523 m²: nine tubes give about 4,703 m², seven about 3,658 m², five about 2,613 m² and two about 1,045 m². Above level 90 the plan is only about 22% of the base, so bending inertia and windward width both drop, and stiffness can change several-fold. Dimensions are from public sources; the ratios are computed.
units.verify: 以模型逐段檢查截止層上下的層間變位、勁度比與構件力，確認沒有形成軟弱層；風洞試驗需涵蓋退縮造成的局部風壓與渦流變化，截止層的帶狀桁架或斜撐以局部模型檢核其傳力。~Check storey drift, stiffness ratios and member forces above and below each termination level in the model to confirm there is no soft storey; wind-tunnel testing must capture local pressures and vortex changes caused by the setbacks, and belt trusses or diagonals at termination levels are checked with local models for force transfer.
units.failure: 若截止層沒有足夠的力量重分配構件，被截止筒的角柱軸力會突然集中到相鄰的筒，造成局部超載或接頭破壞；退縮處的局部風壓若被低估，帷幕與屋頂設備容易在強風中受損。~Without enough redistribution members at a termination level, corner-column forces from the stopped tube concentrate abruptly in the adjacent tube, causing local overload or connection failure; underestimated local wind pressures at setbacks leave cladding and rooftop equipment vulnerable in strong winds.
units.misconception: 束筒的筒體可以在任何樓層隨意截止，不需要特別處理。~Tubes in a bundle can stop at any floor without special treatment.
units.practice: 截止層要在結構圖上特別標示，列出帶狀桁架或斜撐的位置與功能；建築若要變更退縮樓層，須回到結構與風工程顧問重新評估勁度變化與局部風壓。~Flag termination levels on the structural drawings with the position and purpose of belt trusses or diagonals; any change of setback level must go back to the structural and wind consultants to reassess stiffness changes and local pressures.

units.anchor: 預製樹狀柱梁段~Prefabricated column-tree units
units.title: 預製柱梁段與現場螺栓接合~Prefabricated column-tree units with field bolting
units.mechanism: 束筒的每一面框架都由密排柱與深梁組成，接頭數量極多；SOM 指出威利斯大樓的鋼構在工廠預先組成段落，再運到現場以螺栓接合。常見做法是把柱與兩側半跨的梁在工廠焊成「樹狀」單元，焊接品質在室內控制，現場只在梁的中央以螺栓續接。側力作用下框架梁的反曲點大致在跨中，該處彎矩接近零，因此在跨中續接只需傳遞剪力，接頭可以做得簡單而快速。~Every face of a bundled tube is a frame of closely spaced columns and deep beams, so connections are extremely numerous; SOM notes that Willis Tower's steel frame was pre-assembled in sections and bolted together on site. A common approach shop-welds a column with half-span beams on each side into a tree unit, keeping weld quality under indoor control, and splices the beams with bolts only at mid-span on site. Under lateral load the frame beams have their inflection point near mid-span where moment is close to zero, so a mid-span splice need carry only shear and can be simple and quick.
units.model: 側力下梁端彎矩 M = V·L/2：梁剪力 V = 900 kN、淨跨 L = 4.0 m 時柱面彎矩約 1,800 kN·m，跨中接近 0；跨中續接只需傳遞 900 kN 剪力，若每支螺栓承壓容量取 120 kN，需 900/120 = 7.5，取 8 支。數值為教學假設。~Beam-end moment under lateral load M = V·L/2: with a beam shear V = 900 kN and a clear span L = 4.0 m, the moment at the column face is about 1,800 kN·m and near zero at mid-span; a mid-span splice need only carry 900 kN of shear, so at 120 kN bearing capacity per bolt it needs 900/120 = 7.5, rounded to 8 bolts. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 工廠焊接的柱梁接頭以超音波全數檢測，樹狀單元出廠前量測尺寸與扭曲；現場螺栓續接檢查孔位對齊、摩擦面與預拉力，並抽查反曲點假設：以模型確認各種載重組合下續接處的彎矩確實很小，否則需改為抗彎續接。~Ultrasonically test all shop-welded beam-to-column joints and measure dimensions and twist of tree units before dispatch; on site check hole alignment, faying surfaces and pretension of bolted splices, and confirm with the model that moment at the splice really is small under every load combination, otherwise switch to a moment splice.
units.failure: 若某些載重組合（例如重力加風）使反曲點偏離跨中，只按剪力設計的續接會承受未預期的彎矩，螺栓滑動或孔壁撕裂；樹狀單元運輸時若扭曲而未在出廠前發現，現場孔位對不上只能擴孔，削弱接頭。~If some load combination, such as gravity plus wind, moves the inflection point away from mid-span, a splice designed for shear alone takes unexpected moment and its bolts slip or tear the hole walls; tree units twisted in transport and not caught before dispatch force reaming on site, weakening the joint.
units.misconception: 現場螺栓接頭比工廠焊接接頭弱，所以預製單元沒有好處。~Site bolted joints are weaker than shop welds, so prefabricated units bring no benefit.
units.practice: 預製單元的尺寸容許誤差、出廠量測與運輸支撐方式寫入製造規範；續接位置以模型確認反曲點後定案，任何現場擴孔或改孔須經結構工程師同意並記錄。~Write tolerances, dispatch measurement and transport support for prefabricated units into the fabrication specification; fix splice locations only after the model confirms the inflection points, and require the structural engineer's approval and a record for any reaming or re-drilling on site.

units.anchor: 沉箱基礎至岩盤~Caissons to bedrock
units.title: 鋼構束筒的沉箱基礎~Caisson foundations under a steel bundled tube
units.mechanism: 芝加哥市中心的地表下是軟弱的黏土層，超高層無法以淺基礎承載。SOM 說明威利斯大樓的各筒坐落在延伸至岩盤的鋼筋混凝土沉箱上，公開資料記載共有 201 支、直徑最大約 3 m。鋼構束筒的柱子密集且重力與傾覆軸力都直接下傳，每一支柱或柱群需要對應的沉箱；迎風側角柱在強風時軸力減少，背風側增加，沉箱必須同時承受最大壓力並確認不會出現淨上拔。~Downtown Chicago has soft clay below the surface, so a supertall cannot sit on shallow foundations. SOM explains that Willis Tower's tubes rest on reinforced concrete caissons extending to bedrock, recorded publicly as 201 caissons up to about 3 m in diameter. A steel bundled tube has closely spaced columns whose gravity and overturning forces pass straight down, so each column or group needs its own caisson; windward corner columns lose force in strong wind while leeward ones gain, so caissons must carry the peak compression and be checked against net uplift.
units.model: 沉箱底部承壓 q = P/A。直徑 3.0 m，A = π×1.5² ≈ 7.07 m²；柱群傳下 P = 60 MN 時 q ≈ 60/7.07 ≈ 8.5 MPa，若岩盤容許承壓 10 MPa，使用率約 85%。迎風側若軸力因風減少 20 MN，仍有 40 MN 壓力，不會上拔。數值為教學假設。~Caisson base bearing q = P/A. For a 3.0 m diameter, A = π×1.5² ≈ 7.07 m²; a column group delivering P = 60 MN gives q ≈ 60/7.07 ≈ 8.5 MPa, about 85% of an allowable rock bearing of 10 MPa. If wind reduces a windward column group by 20 MN, 40 MN of compression remains and there is no uplift. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每支沉箱開挖到岩盤後由大地工程師檢查岩面、清底與入岩深度並簽認，必要時做岩心或載重試驗；澆置混凝土時防止軟土或地下水侵入，完工後以水準測量追蹤各筒的沉陷是否一致。~After each caisson is excavated to rock, the geotechnical engineer inspects and signs off the rock surface, base cleaning and socket depth, with cores or load tests where needed; prevent soft soil or groundwater intrusion during concreting, and after completion track by levelling whether all tubes settle uniformly.
units.failure: 若沉箱底部殘留軟泥或未真正到達岩盤，該柱群沉陷較大，束筒中相鄰筒之間會產生差異沉陷，梁柱接頭承受附加彎矩；施工時地下水湧入使混凝土離析，沉箱斷面出現缺陷且難以發現。~Soft debris left at the base or a caisson that never truly reaches rock lets that column group settle more, creating differential settlement between adjacent tubes and extra moments at beam-column joints; groundwater inflow during construction segregates the concrete and leaves defects in the shaft that are hard to detect.
units.misconception: 超高層的基礎只要夠深就好，各柱的沉陷差異不重要。~A supertall foundation only needs to be deep enough; differences in settlement between columns do not matter.
units.practice: 每支沉箱設「岩面檢查與清底完成」的停止點，由大地工程師簽認後才可澆置；沉箱的入岩紀錄、試驗資料與沉陷監測一起納入竣工文件，作為日後評估增建或改造的依據。~Set a hold point for every caisson at completion of rock inspection and base cleaning, with concreting only after the geotechnical engineer signs; include socket records, test data and settlement monitoring in the as-built documents as the basis for assessing later additions or retrofits.

units.anchor: 筒體截止處的帶狀桁架~Belt trusses at tube drop-offs
units.title: 筒體截止層的力流重分配與施工~Force redistribution and construction at tube drop-off levels
units.mechanism: 當一個筒在某層截止，它的角柱在下方仍承受由上方與自身累積的軸力，而上方已沒有這個筒的框架；截止層以上的傾覆力也必須改由剩下的筒承擔。威利斯大樓在機械層設有帶狀桁架，並在退縮處下方兩層設置斜向構件以減少剪應力，讓力量在數層的範圍內平順地轉移到繼續往上的筒。施工時這些轉換構件必須在上方荷重增加前完成，否則下方柱會在缺少重分配構件的狀態下承受不均勻荷重。~When a tube stops at a given level, its corner columns below still carry the axial force accumulated from above and from themselves, but the tube's frame no longer exists overhead, and overturning above the termination must be taken by the remaining tubes. Willis Tower has belt trusses at mechanical floors and diagonal members in the two storeys immediately below each setback to reduce shear stress, so force passes smoothly over several floors into the continuing tubes. During construction these transfer members must be completed before the load above builds up, otherwise the columns below carry uneven load without the redistribution members in place.
units.model: 截止層斜桿力 F = ΔN/(2·sinθ)。帶狀桁架深兩層約 7.9 m、柱距 4.57 m，θ = atan(7.9/4.57) ≈ 59.9°；若截止筒角柱須轉移 ΔN = 8 MN，由兩根斜桿分擔，每根約 4/sin59.9° ≈ 4.6 MN。若只有單層高度，角度變平、斜桿力明顯增加。數值為教學假設。~Diagonal force at a termination F = ΔN/(2·sinθ). A belt truss two storeys deep, about 7.9 m, with 4.57 m column spacing gives θ = atan(7.9/4.57) ≈ 59.9°; transferring ΔN = 8 MN from a terminated corner column through two diagonals puts about 4/sin59.9° ≈ 4.6 MN in each. With only one storey of depth the angle flattens and diagonal forces rise markedly. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以施工階段分析檢查截止層的帶狀桁架在各施工時點的受力，確認在上方加載前已完成並鎖緊；完工後在截止層上下的角柱設應變計，比對實測軸力分布與模型預測，確認力量確實經由帶狀桁架轉移。~Check belt-truss forces at termination levels at each construction stage with a construction-stage analysis, confirming they are complete and tightened before load builds above; after completion fit strain gauges to corner columns above and below termination levels and compare measured axial distributions with the model, confirming that force really passes through the belt trusses.
units.failure: 若截止層的帶狀桁架施工落後於上方樓層，下方柱在缺乏重分配的狀態下承受集中荷重，可能產生永久變形；帶狀桁架接頭若在施工期就以全強度鎖定，差異縮短也會在桁架中產生額外內力。~If belt trusses at a termination lag behind the floors above, columns below carry concentrated load without redistribution and may deform permanently; belt-truss joints locked at full strength during construction also pick up extra forces from differential shortening.
units.misconception: 帶狀桁架只是機電層的裝飾性構件，可以晚點再裝。~Belt trusses are decorative members in plant rooms and can go in later.
units.practice: 施工計畫要明列每個截止層的帶狀桁架必須在第幾層樓板施工前完成，並設為停止點；帶狀桁架接頭的鎖定時機與檢查方法由結構設計者核定，完成後記錄於施工日誌。~The construction plan states for each termination level by which floor the belt truss must be complete and makes it a hold point; the structural designer sets the timing and inspection method for locking belt-truss joints, and completion is recorded in the site diary.

units.anchor: 混凝土六角束筒~Hexagonal concrete bundle
units.title: 混凝土六角束筒：One Magnificent Mile~A hexagonal concrete bundle: One Magnificent Mile
units.mechanism: 束筒不一定是鋼構方筒。芝加哥的 One Magnificent Mile（1983 年完工、約 205 m、57 層）由 SOM 設計，結構工程師為 Fazlur Khan，以四個高度不同（5、21、49、57 層）的六角形鋼筋混凝土筒束在一起，配合住宅與辦公的不同樓層需求。混凝土框架筒以較厚的外牆與窗間梁形成筒壁，筒與筒共用的牆同時是腹面；六角形平面讓相同樓地板面積所需的周邊框架長度較短，並提供較多的景觀面。~A bundled tube need not be square steel tubes. Chicago's One Magnificent Mile (completed 1983, about 205 m, 57 floors), designed by SOM with Fazlur Khan as structural engineer, bundles four hexagonal reinforced concrete tubes of different heights, 5, 21, 49 and 57 floors, to suit the different floor needs of residential and office uses. A concrete framed tube forms its walls from thick perimeter piers and spandrels, and walls shared between tubes act as webs; the hexagonal plan needs a shorter perimeter frame for the same floor area and offers more view frontage.
units.model: 周長比較：邊長 s = 15 m 的正六角形面積 A = (3√3/2)·s² ≈ 584.6 m²，周長 6s = 90 m；同面積正方形邊長 √584.6 ≈ 24.18 m，周長約 96.7 m。六角形少用約 6.9% 的周邊框架，對以周邊框架抗側的筒體而言，可省下相對比例的牆柱與帷幕。數值為教學假設。~Perimeter comparison: a regular hexagon with side s = 15 m has area A = (3√3/2)·s² ≈ 584.6 m² and perimeter 6s = 90 m; a square of the same area has side √584.6 ≈ 24.18 m and perimeter about 96.7 m. The hexagon needs about 6.9% less perimeter frame, saving a similar share of piers, spandrels and cladding in a tube that resists lateral load with its perimeter. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 混凝土束筒的施工以爬模逐層澆置，每層檢查筒壁厚度、窗洞尺寸與窗間梁鋼筋；筒與筒共用牆的施工縫位置須經設計者核可，並以試體與鑽心確認強度。完工後量測各筒截止處的變位與裂縫，確認勁度突變處沒有異常。~Concrete bundles are built floor by floor with climbing forms, checking wall thickness, window sizes and spandrel reinforcement at every level; construction-joint locations in shared walls need the designer's approval, with strength confirmed by specimens and cores. After completion measure deflections and cracking at each tube termination to confirm nothing abnormal at the stiffness changes.
units.failure: 混凝土窗間梁是剪力滯後的關鍵，若施工時保護層過厚或箍筋不足，梁在反覆風載與地震下開裂，筒壁勁度下降；共用牆若在不當位置留施工縫，腹面的剪力傳遞會在縫處削弱。~Concrete spandrels govern shear lag; with excessive cover or too few stirrups they crack under repeated wind and earthquake loading and the tube walls lose stiffness; construction joints in the wrong place in shared walls weaken shear transfer in the webs.
units.misconception: 束筒只能用鋼構，混凝土做不出筒體效果。~Bundled tubes only work in steel; concrete cannot give tube action.
units.practice: 混凝土框架筒的窗間梁配筋、窗洞尺寸與施工縫位置列為重點檢查項目，並設澆置前停止點；建築若要放大窗洞，須回到結構設計者重新評估窗間梁與剪力滯後。~Make spandrel reinforcement, window sizes and construction-joint locations key inspection items in a concrete framed tube, with a hold point before each pour; any request to enlarge windows goes back to the structural designer to reassess spandrels and shear lag.

units.anchor: 邊界層風洞與設計陣風~Boundary-layer wind tunnel and design gusts
units.title: 邊界層風洞試驗與束筒外形~Boundary-layer wind-tunnel testing of the bundled form
units.mechanism: 威利斯大樓的設計團隊與西安大略大學的邊界層風洞實驗室（Alan G. Davenport 風工程團隊）合作，這類風洞會在模型上游模擬近地面的紊流邊界層，讓風速隨高度增加並帶有真實的陣風結構。束筒的逐段退縮使不同高度的寬度與形狀改變，風力分布與渦流脫落都和單一方塊不同，必須以試驗確認。公開資料指出結構設計可承受約 130 mph（約 210 km/h）的陣風；風洞結果用於整體風載、層間變位、帷幕風壓與居住舒適度。~Willis Tower's designers worked with the Boundary Layer Wind Tunnel Laboratory at the University of Western Ontario, Alan G. Davenport's wind engineering group; such tunnels simulate the turbulent boundary layer near the ground upstream of the model, so wind speed increases with height and carries realistic gust structure. The bundle's staged setbacks change width and shape with height, so wind-force distribution and vortex shedding differ from a single block and must be confirmed by testing. Public sources state the structure was designed for gusts of about 130 mph (about 210 km/h); wind-tunnel results feed overall wind loads, storey drift, cladding pressures and occupant comfort.
units.model: 動壓 q = ½·ρ·V²。V = 130 mph ≈ 58.1 m/s，q = 0.5×1.225×58.1² ≈ 2.07 kPa；以 C_d = 1.3、寬 68.6 m、高 442 m 均布估算，總風力約 2.07×1.3×68.6×442 ≈ 81.5 MN，基底彎矩約 81.5×221 ≈ 18.0 GN·m。均布假設偏保守，實際應以風洞剖面為準。係數為教學假設。~Dynamic pressure q = ½·ρ·V². At V = 130 mph ≈ 58.1 m/s, q = 0.5×1.225×58.1² ≈ 2.07 kPa; spread uniformly with C_d = 1.3 over a 68.6 m width and 442 m height, the total force is about 2.07×1.3×68.6×442 ≈ 81.5 MN and the base moment about 81.5×221 ≈ 18.0 GN·m. The uniform assumption is conservative; the wind-tunnel profile governs. Coefficients are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 比較風洞量得的基底彎矩、頂層加速度與規範估算，並檢查周邊建築與地形在模型中的模擬範圍；退縮處與屋頂的局部風壓係數用於帷幕設計，結果須經獨立的風工程同儕審查。~Compare wind-tunnel base moments and top-floor accelerations with code estimates, checking how far surrounding buildings and terrain were modelled; use local pressure coefficients at setbacks and the roof for cladding design, with the results subject to independent wind-engineering peer review.
units.failure: 若只以均勻風速剖面或忽略周邊建築做試驗，可能低估都市環境中的紊流與陣風效應，造成居住舒適度不足或帷幕在退縮處受損；周邊新建大樓也可能改變既有建築的風環境，需重新評估。~Testing with a uniform wind profile or without surrounding buildings can underestimate urban turbulence and gust effects, leaving comfort inadequate or cladding damaged at setbacks; new towers nearby can also change an existing building's wind environment and call for reassessment.
units.misconception: 風洞試驗只是驗證規範的結果，可有可無。~Wind-tunnel testing merely confirms code results and is optional.
units.practice: 風洞報告與模型照片納入竣工文件；周邊有大型新建案時，業主應請風工程顧問評估對既有大樓風載與帷幕風壓的影響，並決定是否需要補充試驗。~Include the wind-tunnel report and model photographs in the as-built documents; when large new developments rise nearby, the owner should have a wind consultant assess the effect on the existing tower's wind loads and cladding pressures and decide whether further testing is needed.

units.anchor: 柱軸向應變量測~Column axial-strain measurement
units.title: 以柱應變驗證剪力滯後分布~Verifying shear-lag distribution from column strains
units.mechanism: 剪力滯後的程度取決於窗間梁與接頭的實際勁度，模型假設可能與實際不同。在翼面的角柱、中間柱與內部腹框柱上安裝應變計，可在強風時量測軸力分布，直接計算中央與角柱的比值，驗證束筒的內部腹框是否確實改善了滯後。量測需扣除重力與溫度造成的應變，只保留風引起的變化部分，並與同時段的風速風向對應。~The degree of shear lag depends on the actual stiffness of spandrels and joints, which may differ from model assumptions. Strain gauges on flange corner columns, intermediate columns and interior web-frame columns measure the axial-force distribution during strong winds, giving the centre-to-corner ratio directly and verifying whether the bundle's interior webs really reduce shear lag. Measurements must remove strain from gravity and temperature, keeping only the wind-induced change, matched to concurrent wind speed and direction.
units.model: 由實測風致應變求比值：角柱 120 με、翼面中央柱 80 με，r = 80/120 ≈ 0.67，效率 η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − 0.67) ≈ 0.78；若模型預測 r = 0.85（η = 0.90），代表實際滯後較模型嚴重，角柱實際軸力比設計估計高約 0.90/0.78 − 1 ≈ 15%。數值為教學假設。~Ratio from measured wind strains: corner column 120 με and mid-flange column 80 με give r = 80/120 ≈ 0.67 and η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − 0.67) ≈ 0.78; if the model predicted r = 0.85 (η = 0.90), the real shear lag is worse than modelled and corner-column force is about 0.90/0.78 − 1 ≈ 15% higher than estimated. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 選擇風向穩定、風速高的事件，計算各柱應變相對於無風基準的變化，並以同一斷面的兩側應變分離軸力與彎曲；把實測比值與模型比較，差異大時以實測資料校正窗間梁與接頭勁度，再重新檢核角柱與續接容量。~Select events with steady direction and high wind speed, compute each column's strain change relative to a calm baseline, and separate axial force from bending using gauges on both sides of each section; compare measured ratios with the model and, where they differ widely, calibrate spandrel and joint stiffness from the data and recheck corner-column and splice capacity.
units.failure: 若只在角柱裝應變計，無法判斷滯後程度；未扣除日照造成的溫度應變，可能把東西向立面的日夜溫差誤判為風載軸力，得出錯誤結論。~Gauges only on corner columns cannot show the degree of shear lag; failing to remove solar temperature strain can mistake day–night differences on east and west elevations for wind-induced axial force and lead to wrong conclusions.
units.misconception: 模型算出的柱軸力分布一定和實際相同，不需要量測。~The column-force distribution computed by the model must match reality, so no measurement is needed.
units.practice: 監測規劃要同時在角柱、翼面中央柱與腹框柱設點，並設置溫度感測器與風速計；資料格式與處理方法隨交接文件提供，讓後續的改造或評估能以實測為基準。~Plan monitoring points on corner, mid-flange and web-frame columns together, with temperature sensors and anemometers; supply data formats and processing methods with the handover documents so later retrofits or assessments can start from measured behaviour.

units.anchor: 外殼與溫度變形~Envelope and thermal movement
units.title: 黑色鋁皮與青銅色玻璃外殼的溫度效應~Thermal effects behind the black aluminium skin
units.mechanism: SOM 指出威利斯大樓的黑色鋁板與青銅色玻璃外殼具有隔熱作用，使室內溫度維持相對穩定，進而限制鋼構架的熱脹冷縮。對 400 m 以上的鋼構而言，外圍柱若直接暴露在芝加哥冬夏的溫差中，而內部腹框柱維持室溫，兩者的長度變化不同，會讓樓板在外圍與內部之間傾斜，並在梁與接頭中產生附加內力。外殼的隔熱與氣密因此不只是節能問題，也是結構變形控制的一部分。~SOM notes that Willis Tower's black aluminium and bronze-tinted glass skin acts as insulation, keeping the interior temperature relatively constant and so limiting thermal expansion and contraction of the steel frame. For a steel structure over 400 m tall, exterior columns exposed to Chicago's winter-to-summer swings while interior web-frame columns stay at room temperature change length differently, tilting floors between the perimeter and the interior and inducing extra forces in beams and joints. The envelope's insulation and airtightness are therefore not only an energy issue but part of controlling structural deformation.
units.model: 外柱與內柱的長度差 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、L = 400 m：若外柱與內柱溫差 30 °C，ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×400,000×30 = 144 mm，相距 22.86 m 的樓板傾斜約 1/159；外殼隔熱把溫差降到 10 °C 時 ΔL = 48 mm，傾斜約 1/476。數值為教學假設。~Length difference between exterior and interior columns ΔL = α·L·ΔT. With α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C and L = 400 m, a 30 °C difference gives ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×400,000×30 = 144 mm, tilting a floor spanning 22.86 m by about 1/159; insulation that cuts the difference to 10 °C gives ΔL = 48 mm and a tilt of about 1/476. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在外圍柱與內部柱設置溫度感測器，冬季與夏季各量測一次柱溫分布，並以精密水準量測樓板高程差，與熱分析預測比較；外殼更新或改造前，評估新材料的隔熱性能對柱溫與結構變形的影響。~Install temperature sensors on perimeter and interior columns, measure column temperature distribution once in winter and once in summer, survey slab level differences by precise levelling and compare with thermal analysis; before any envelope renewal or retrofit, assess how the new materials' insulation will affect column temperatures and structural deformation.
units.failure: 若外殼改造時移除或削弱了柱周圍的隔熱，冬季外柱收縮使外圍樓板下沉，隔間牆、門框與帷幕接縫開裂；長期反覆的溫度變形也會讓接頭螺栓鬆動。~If an envelope retrofit removes or weakens insulation around the columns, winter contraction of the exterior columns lowers perimeter floors, cracking partitions, door frames and façade joints; repeated thermal deformation over the years can also loosen connection bolts.
units.misconception: 外牆只是建築外觀與節能，與鋼構架的變形無關。~The façade concerns only appearance and energy, not the deformation of the steel frame.
units.practice: 交接文件要說明外殼隔熱在結構設計中的角色，並列出柱溫度假設；任何外殼更新、窗戶更換或柱周圍隔熱拆除，須先經結構工程師評估溫度變形影響。~Handover documents should explain the envelope insulation's role in the structural design and list the column temperature assumptions; any envelope renewal, window replacement or removal of insulation around columns needs the structural engineer's assessment of thermal deformation first.

units.anchor: 既有束筒超高層的改造~Retrofitting an existing bundled tube
units.title: 既有束筒超高層的改造與交接紀錄~Retrofitting and handover records for an existing bundled-tube supertall
units.mechanism: 威利斯大樓完工後持續改造：西側天線於 2000 年延長，使頂端高度達到 527 m；2009 年起觀景台翻修，2016 至 2021 年再進行大規模改造。每一次增設天線、觀景設施或改變用途，都會在屋頂或特定樓層增加荷重與受風面積，必須回溯原設計的筒體、帶狀桁架與基礎容量。原始圖說、施工紀錄與歷次改造資料若不完整，評估者只能以保守假設或破壞性調查補足，成本與風險都會增加。~Willis Tower has been altered repeatedly since completion: the west antenna was extended in 2000, bringing the tip to 527 m; the Skydeck was renovated from 2009; and a major retrofit ran from 2016 to 2021. Every new antenna, visitor attraction or change of use adds load and wind area on the roof or particular floors, so the capacity of the original tubes, belt trusses and foundations must be traced back. If original drawings, construction records and earlier alteration data are incomplete, assessors must fall back on conservative assumptions or destructive investigation, adding cost and risk.
units.model: 天線風力 F = q·C_d·D·L。q = 2.07 kPa、C_d = 1.2、直徑 D = 1.5 m、伸出屋頂 L = 85 m：F ≈ 2.07×1.2×1.5×85 ≈ 317 kN，屋頂處彎矩 M = F·L/2 ≈ 13,460 kN·m，須由屋頂框架與下方筒體承擔並檢核接頭疲勞。數值為教學假設。~Wind force on an antenna F = q·C_d·D·L. With q = 2.07 kPa, C_d = 1.2, diameter D = 1.5 m and L = 85 m above the roof, F ≈ 2.07×1.2×1.5×85 ≈ 317 kN and the roof moment M = F·L/2 ≈ 13,460 kN·m, which the roof framing and tubes below must carry, with connection fatigue checked. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 改造前調閱原始圖說與歷次改造紀錄，以現場量測確認構件尺寸與接頭狀況，必要時取樣試驗鋼材強度與韌性；新增荷重以模型檢核相關筒體與基礎，完成後更新竣工圖與結構資料庫，並記錄新增設備的重量與受風面積。~Before any alteration, retrieve original drawings and earlier alteration records, confirm member sizes and joint condition by site survey, and where needed sample the steel for strength and toughness; check the added loads on the relevant tubes and foundations with the model, then update the as-built drawings and structural database, recording the weight and wind area of new equipment.
units.failure: 若改造只檢查新增構件本身而未回溯到下方的筒體與基礎，多次小改造的累積荷重可能超過原設計餘裕；資料遺失時，評估者可能誤判構件的實際尺寸或材料，導致補強不足或過度。~Checking only the new members without tracing load down through the tubes and foundations lets the accumulated load of many small alterations exceed the original margin; with records lost, assessors may misjudge actual member sizes or materials, leading to too little or too much strengthening.
units.misconception: 老建築已經通過時間考驗，增加一些設備不需要結構評估。~An old building has stood the test of time, so adding some equipment needs no structural assessment.
units.practice: 業主應維護一份「結構荷重登錄」，記錄每次改造新增或移除的重量、位置與受風面積，並與原設計容量比較；交接時把原始圖說、改造紀錄與量測資料數位化保存，任何改造須經結構工程師審查簽認。~The owner should keep a structural load register recording the weight, location and wind area added or removed by every alteration and comparing them with original design capacity; at handover digitise original drawings, alteration records and measurements, and require structural engineer review and sign-off for every alteration.

example: 剪力滯後與抗傾覆練習：某鋼構框架筒翼面寬 68.6 m，翼面共 16 支柱、每支 0.06 m²，角柱容許應力 200 MPa。以力偶近似抗傾覆能力 M ≈ η·σ_c·ΣA·B。單一大筒中央與角柱應力比 r = 0.4，η = 1 − (2/3)(0.6) = 0.60，M ≈ 0.60×200×10⁶×(16×0.06)×68.6 ≈ 7.9 GN·m；改為 3×3 束筒，內部腹框使 r 提高到 0.85，η = 0.90，M ≈ 11.9 GN·m，增加約 50%。若窗間梁變淺使單筒 r 降到 0.3，η ≈ 0.53，M 只剩約 7.0 GN·m。也就是說，在角柱應力相同的前提下，束筒的內部腹框把同樣的鋼柱變成更有效的抗傾覆力偶；代價是內部多了框架線，影響平面使用。數值為教學假設，不代表威利斯大樓的設計值。~Shear lag and overturning exercise: a steel framed tube has a 68.6 m flange with 16 columns of 0.06 m² each and an allowable corner stress of 200 MPa. Approximating overturning resistance as a couple, M ≈ η·σ_c·ΣA·B. For a single large tube with a centre-to-corner ratio r = 0.4, η = 1 − (2/3)(0.6) = 0.60 and M ≈ 0.60×200×10⁶×(16×0.06)×68.6 ≈ 7.9 GN·m; as a 3×3 bundle whose interior webs raise r to 0.85, η = 0.90 and M ≈ 11.9 GN·m, about 50% more. If shallower spandrels drop the single tube's r to 0.3, η ≈ 0.53 and M falls to about 7.0 GN·m. For the same corner stress, then, the bundle's interior webs turn the same steel columns into a more effective overturning couple, at the price of extra interior frame lines that affect floor planning. Values are teaching assumptions, not Willis Tower's design values.
history: SOM 芝加哥事務所的結構工程師 Fazlur Rahman Khan 在 1960 年代提出依高度選擇結構系統的觀念，把框架筒推廣為高層建築的經濟解法，芝加哥 DeWitt-Chestnut 公寓被視為第一棟框架筒建築。為了讓筒體不必是單一方盒並減少剪力滯後，Khan 與建築師 Bruce Graham 在西爾斯大樓（今威利斯大樓）把九個方筒束在一起，1970 年開工、1973 年封頂、1974 年完工，以 442 m 成為 1974 至 1998 年的世界最高建築；1983 年的 One Magnificent Mile 則以四個六角形混凝土筒延伸這個系統。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~In the 1960s Fazlur Rahman Khan, structural engineer in SOM's Chicago office, introduced the idea of choosing a structural system by height and promoted the framed tube as an economical solution for tall buildings, with Chicago's DeWitt-Chestnut Apartments regarded as the first framed-tube building. To free the tube from being a single box and to reduce shear lag, Khan and architect Bruce Graham bundled nine square tubes in the Sears Tower, now Willis Tower, which began in 1970, topped out in 1973 and was completed in 1974, standing at 442 m as the world's tallest building from 1974 to 1998; One Magnificent Mile in 1983 extended the system with four hexagonal concrete tubes. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 威利斯大樓建築高度 442.1 m，地上 108 層，1974 年完工~Willis Tower is 442.1 m tall with 108 floors above ground, completed in 1974
九個約 22.9 m（75 ft）見方的筒以 3×3 排列，底部約 68.6 m 見方~Nine tubes about 22.9 m (75 ft) square in a 3×3 grid, about 68.6 m square at the base
筒體分別在第 50、66 與 90 層截止，第 90 層以上剩 2 個筒~Tubes stop at levels 50, 66 and 90, leaving 2 tubes above level 90
鋼材約 74,000 短噸（約 67,000 公噸）~About 74,000 short tons (about 67,000 t) of steel
以 201 支直徑最大約 3 m 的沉箱支承至岩盤~Supported on 201 caissons up to about 3 m in diameter founded on bedrock
